_comment: All tunable game numbers. A plain number is a confirmed rule from CLAUDE.md. An object with "placeholder": true, or with "status": "placeholder" (health block), is a temporary value that is not decided yet; read it through Config.get_value(), which returns its "value".

first_day_start_hour.comment: Clock time (24 h) when the first day starts.

max_sleep_hours.comment: Maximum hours on the sleep slider.

max_frame_seconds.comment: Longest real time counted in one frame, so a frozen or hidden tab cannot jump game time forward.

step_avatar_min.comment: Milestone 10: the health system updates in fixed steps of this many avatar minutes (v1, Update order).

daylight._comment: Only how the sky looks. Being awake or asleep follows the time rules above, not these hours.

twilight_hours.comment: Length of dawn and dusk, centred on start_hour and end_hour, when the sky fades between day and night.

autosave_real_seconds.comment: Extra safety save every this many real seconds while the game is open.

resume_paused.comment: If true, a day in progress is paused when the game is reopened, so time only starts when the player presses pause again.

debug._comment: Only works when the game runs from the Godot editor. Press F9 to change the speed. Never active in the published build.

measures._comment: The starting physical, mental and sleep measures and the body states come from the chosen difficulty (health.difficulties).

calories_spent_start.comment: Total kcal spent by exercise so far. Whether it resets each day is not decided.

slider_min_hours.comment: Smallest value on the sleep slider. The largest is time.max_sleep_hours.

slider_default_hours.comment: Where the slider starts. 10 h is the baseline sleep.

activity_slider._comment: The minutes slider shown before an activity with "minutes_slider": true in data/activities.json. It starts at the option's duration_hours. The limits are an open decision in the concept.

max_minutes.comment: Largest value. High enough for the 4 h of cardio in the v1 scenarios, so too much exercise stays possible and has its consequences.

_comment_v1: Milestone 10: the groups units, body, energy, appetite, meals, deficit, train, minigame, diet, sleep, mood, health, fail, risk, progress and avatar_states hold every value of Health Calculation Architecture v1 (documentation/health_calculation_architecture_v1.md, section Parameters and Steps 1 to 12). Each value has a status (placeholder, team decision or from source) and an owner (Pessoa 1 to 4, or team). Time constants say in their name or comment whether they are body time (multiplied by body.k) or clock time. Food values are in data/foods.json, METy of each activity in data/activities.json, and the WHO tables in data/who_bmi_for_age.json and data/who_height_for_age.json. (The Milestone 4 health block health_m4 was deleted in Milestone 10 Task 8.)

units._comment: Fixed unit conversions, kept here so the health scripts hold no numbers.

who._comment: WHO growth reference 5 to 19 years (2007). Tables in data/who_bmi_for_age.json and data/who_height_for_age.json. Ages between two months are interpolated in a straight line; ages outside the tables use the first or last month.

extension_from_z.comment: WHO computation of z-scores: above +3 (and below -3) z = 3 + (BMI - SD3) / (SD3 - SD2), because the LMS curve is not used there.

k.comment: Body speed (v1 Step 1; team, 25 Oct 2026): body hours = k x avatar hours. Applies to weight, body age, fitness and strength levels, diet quality, craving, sleep-debt recovery and disease damage. Not to the clock, hours slept, minutes per day, sessions per week, recovery between sessions, meal timing, habituation or happiness.

kcal_per_kg.comment: Energy per kg of body weight change. Used with a BMR that depends on weight, so weight settles (Hall 2011).

child.comment: Reference age of the child group: 10 years.

teenager.comment: Reference age of the teenager group: 14 years.

child.comment: Decision 8 (user, 25 Oct 2026): the body grows only inside its age group. A child stops at 12 years 11 months.

teenager.comment: A teenager stops at 18 years 11 months (the WHO table ends at 19 years).

bmr._comment: Basal metabolic rate in kcal per day = per_kg x weight + base (Schofield 1985, used by FAO/WHO/UNU 1985). below_10: 3 to 10 years; from_10: 10 to 18 years.

bmr_band_from_months.comment: Body age (months) from which the 10 to 18 years equation is used.

pal_ref.comment: Reference appetite = BMR at the healthy weight for the current age and height x this: the energy needs of an active child of healthy weight (IOM activity levels); calibrated in the v1 simulation.

mety_idle.comment: METy of a normal school-day hour when no activity runs. Calibrated. The METy of sleep and of each activity is in data/activities.json.

record_intensities.comment: The kcal spent during activities with one of these activity_intensity values add up in the calories-spent record shown in the physical box (a record only).

appetite._comment: v1 Step 4. Every avatar hour: hunger += (habit_share x reference / 24 + (1 - habit_share) x energy spent this hour) x (1 + sleep_debt_boost x d) x (1 + thin_boost_per_sd x max(0, -z)). Hunger is in kcal and grows during sleep too.

sleep_debt_boost.comment: Up to 20% more appetite with sleep debt (Al Khatib 2017: about +385 kcal a day).

thin_boost_per_sd.comment: The body defends against weight loss below the median.

meals._comment: v1 Step 4. Healthy portion = reference / per_day_ref kcal. The food options (portion factor, satiety, healthy or not) are in data/foods.json; the meal's duration is in data/activities.json.

hungry_trigger.comment: "I'm hungry!" when hunger is at least this many healthy meals (clock time).

min_gap_h.comment: ...and at least this many avatar hours have passed since the last meal or skip (clock time).

start_hunger_meals.comment: Hunger of a new avatar, in healthy meals: ready for breakfast (v1: the avatar wakes up ready for breakfast). Not in v1.

deficit._comment: Energy deficit penalty U (v1 Step 5; IOC 2023 REDs idea): deficit = 1 - kcal eaten / kcal spent in the last window_h avatar hours. U = 0 below start, rising in a straight line to 1 at full.

train_cut.comment: Fitness and strength targets and gains x (1 - train_cut x U).

train._comment: v1 Step 6. Daily capacity = (capacity_base_min + capacity_fit_min x fitness) x (1 - capacity_sleep_cut x d) minutes of moderate-to-vigorous activity per avatar day. Target = target_floor + target_range x (1 - e^(-target_rate x minutes / ref_min)).

cardio_types.comment: Activity options that count as cardio for training (v1 Step 6: cardio and football give A_cardio). Their minutes, and those of strength_types, use up the daily capacity.

strength_types.comment: Activity options that count as strength training.

capacity_base_min.comment: WHO 2020: 60 min a day. Clock time.

capacity_fit_min.comment: A very fit avatar tolerates 60 + 90 = 150 minutes.

average_window_h.comment: Effective minutes per day, averaged over this many avatar hours (clock time), give A_cardio and A_strength. With 24 h, strength trained 3 days a week rises and falls through the week (Milestone 10.5 parity run: 0.60 to 0.69 over days 14 to 21, 0.61 at day 21); a week (168 h) gives the weekly average (0.76 at day 21; v1 0.70). Team to decide.

strength_ref_min.comment: About three 45-minute sessions a week (AAP 2020). Clock time.

fitness_strength_share.comment: Share of strength minutes that count for fitness.

strength_cardio_share.comment: Share of cardio minutes that count for strength.

target_rate.comment: 60 effective minutes a day give a fitness target of 0.88.

fitness_tau_days.comment: Body time: real days (3.0 avatar days with k = 10).

strength_tau_days.comment: Body time: real days (4.2 avatar days with k = 10).

sleep_gain_cut.comment: Fitness and strength gains x (1 - sleep_gain_cut x d).

overreach_gain_cut.comment: Training gains x (1 - overreach_gain_cut x O).

overreach_tau_h.comment: O is the average of the excess minutes per day over about this many avatar hours (clock time).

overreach_ref_min.comment: O = average excess minutes per day / this, from 0 to 1.

cardio_tire_min.comment: Cardio and football fully tire the body after this many continuous minutes.

strength_recovery_h.comment: Clock time; 86% recovered after 48 h (AAP 2020: non-consecutive days).

strength_ready.comment: A strength session that starts below this recovery counts as too soon: it gives no effective minutes, and all its minutes build overreaching (user decision, 25 Oct 2026).

strength_min_gap_h.comment: Milestone 10.5 (team review, 27 Oct 2026): a strength session that starts less than this many avatar hours (clock time) after the start of the previous strength session is too soon as well, so strength every day does less good than 2 to 3 non-consecutive days a week (AAP 2020). Plans with 48 h or more between sessions are not affected.

minigame._comment: Performance = min_performance + (1 - min_performance) x score x (1 - tired_cut x tiredness). The cardio minigame (Milestone 12, sources in MILESTONE_12.md): capacity = fitness x body x (1 - capacity_tired_cut x tiredness); one tap is one stride.

default_score.comment: Decision 5: used by activities without a minigame, and when no player is there (the scenario tests).

steps_per_tap.comment: Decision 24: one tap is one stride. Real cadences would need more than 2 taps a second otherwise.

child.comment: Steps per minute at 4 METy, ages 9 to 11. CADENCE-kids (Tudor-Locke 2018), Table 4, heuristic thresholds.
Steps per minute at 6 METy, ages 9 to 11. CADENCE-kids, Table 4, heuristic thresholds.

walk_cadence_share.comment: Cadence while getting the breath back, as a share of the moderate threshold: below moderate intensity.

weight_cut_per_z.comment: Capacity lost per z above 0. At z +2 (WHO obesity) capacity is 0.68 times: about 25 against 36.5 ml/kg/min of peak oxygen uptake (Frontiers in Physiology 2021, PMC8155533). The studies agree on the direction; the size varies.

body_floor.comment: The body term never goes below this.

run_minutes_base.comment: Avatar minutes of running at capacity 0 before the Breath bar is empty.

run_minutes_range.comment: Added at capacity 1, which gives train.cardio_tire_min (120).

walk_recover_min.comment: Avatar minutes of walking that would refill the whole Breath bar. Children recover quickly (Birat 2018).

run_again_at.comment: Share of the Breath bar at which the avatar can run again.

walk_mety.comment: Energy while walking: the top of this walk is about moderate intensity, 4 METy in CADENCE-kids.

on_beat_share.comment: A tap this share of the interval away from it is on the beat.

min_gap_share.comment: A tap sooner than this share of the interval is not a stride: the leg cannot move that fast.

rhythm_weight.comment: Score = this x rhythm + the rest x pace (decision 22: both count).

score_window_strides.comment: Rhythm and pace are averages of about this many last strides, so the score follows the player (decision 20).

stall_seconds.comment: Real seconds without a tap until the avatar stands still and waits.

wait_seconds.comment: Decision 28: real seconds the avatar waits for a tap before the activity ends.

strength_weight_cut_per_z.comment: Strength capacity lost per z above 0. At z +2 (WHO obesity) it is 0.76 times: force per body weight about 24% lower with obesity; 12 to 36% lower by joint (Theis 2019).

reps_min.comment: Repetitions per set at capacity 0. AAP 2020: beginners, 1 to 2 sets of 8 to 12.

reps_max.comment: Repetitions per set at capacity 1. AAP 2020.

sets_min.comment: Sets for the weakest avatar. AAP 2020.

sets_max.comment: Sets for the strongest avatar. AAP 2020: later 2 to 4 sets. More sets can follow while time is left (decision 36).

press_seconds.comment: Real seconds between Down and Up: a controlled pace. The AAP gives no number.

reps_margin.comment: A rested avatar could do this many times its repetitions: the set ends without undue fatigue (AAP 2020).

rest_seconds.comment: Real seconds of rest between sets, about 4 avatar minutes. The AAP's 1 minute would be 86 real seconds at this time scale.

rest_refill.comment: Share of the Muscle bar that one rest refills, so later sets are shorter.

football._comment: Football minigame (Milestone 14, decisions 39 to 46, MILESTONE_14.md). No study gives these numbers: all are placeholders. Distances are field units, about metres. Time is real seconds.

field_middle.comment: The share of the field that is its middle.

tick_seconds.comment: The match runs in fixed steps of this length.

formation.comment: Place of each player as shares of width and length, own goal at 0. The first is the avatar or the other team's first player. Mirrored for the other team.

follow_share.comment: How far the team follows the ball up and down the field.

jog_share.comment: Speed while jogging with an empty Breath bar.

cpu_speed.comment: Computer players: the same at every difficulty.

control_radius.comment: A loose ball this close is picked up.

intercept_radius.comment: An opponent this close to a pass takes it.

free_distance_max.comment: A team-mate is free at this distance from any opponent, at capacity 0.

shot_range_min.comment: A shot from this far is good, at capacity 0.

tackle_seconds.comment: The avatar can try a tackle this often.

tackle_chance.comment: A tackle within reach wins the ball this often.

cpu_tackle_seconds.comment: Computer players try a tackle at most this often.

cpu_decide_seconds.comment: A computer player with the ball decides this often.

cpu_press_radius.comment: A computer player with an opponent this close passes.

quiet_recover_min.comment: Avatar minutes of standing still that would refill the whole bar.

active_window_seconds.comment: The staying-active share is an average over about this long (decision 42).

diet._comment: v1 Step 7. At each meal (x = 1 healthy, 0 fast food) Q, C and A move toward their target by 1 / (time constant in avatar days x meals.per_day_ref). Q and C use body time (divided by body.k), A clock time.

quality_tau_days.comment: Diet quality Q. Body time: real days (2.1 avatar days, about 8 meals).

craving_tau_days.comment: Fast-food craving C. Body time (3 avatar days, about 12 meals); children need about 8 to 15 tries to accept a new food.

habituation_tau_days.comment: Habituation A to fast-food pleasure. Clock time: avatar days (about 20 meals).

sleep._comment: v1 Step 9. Recommended sleep per 24 h by age group (AASM 2016). At each new day: debt = debt x e^(-(slept / target) x 24 / (debt_recovery_tau_days x 24 / body.k)) + max(0, minimum - slept); Sleep = (1 - min(1, debt / debt_ref_h)) x (1 - min(oversleep_cut_max, oversleep_cut_per_h x oversleep)); d = min(1, debt / debt_ref_h).

debt_recovery_tau_days.comment: Body time (Kitamura 2016, adults: 1 h of chronic debt took 4 days to recover). With k = 10, a full night repays 86% of the debt.

debt_ref_h.comment: Sleep measure is 0 at this much debt or more.

oversleep_cut_per_h.comment: AASM 2016: long sleep is also linked to worse health.

can_sleep_debt_h.comment: The avatar can sleep only with at least this much debt, or after can_sleep_awake_h awake (clock time).

wake_extra_max_h.comment: The avatar wakes never later than the maximum of the range + min(debt, this).

tired_awake_from_h.comment: Tiredness = max(d, (hours awake - tired_awake_from_h) / tired_awake_range_h), at most 1.

night_quality_power.comment: Night quality = (slept / minimum)^power when short, 1 in the range, 1 - oversleep_cut_per_h per hour of oversleep (at least 1 - oversleep_cut_max).

mood._comment: Happiness (0 to 1), v1 Step 10. Moves toward the baseline with tau_h (clock time; k does not apply) and jumps with events. Baseline = base + physical x Physical + sleep x Sleep + diet x Q + fun x Fun - deficit x U - screen_excess x screen excess - overreach x O.

screen_excess.comment: Orben and Przybylski 2019: small negative link.

fun._comment: Fun = average over window_h of (football minutes x football + screen minutes x screens (only the first screen_max_min of the day) + exercise minutes x exercise) / full_at_min, at most 1.

screen_max_min.comment: Canadian 24-Hour Movement Guidelines (2016): 2 h of recreational screens a day.

football_types.comment: Activity options that count as football for fun and happiness.

screen_types.comment: Activity options that count as recreational screens (fun, screen excess, the wish for screens).

exercise_types.comment: Activity options that count as exercise for fun, the dislike of starting it, and the happiness of exercise within or beyond capacity.

screen_excess_from_min.comment: Screen excess = (average daily screen minutes - this) / screen_excess_range_min, from 0 to 1.

meal.comment: Healthy meal: meal - meal_craving x C. Fast-food meal: meal + meal_craving x C x (1 - A).

start_exercise.comment: Starting cardio or strength: start_exercise x (1 - fitness) (it does not want to exercise).

exercise_per_h.comment: Cardio or strength within capacity, x (1 - exercise_tired_cut x tiredness).

screens_per_h.comment: Only the first mood.fun.screen_max_min minutes of the day.

no_screens_after_h.comment: Wish refused: this many awake hours without screens.

hungry_per_h.comment: While awake and hunger is above hungry_at_meals healthy meals.

wake.comment: Waking up: wake x (night quality - wake_mid).

kept_awake_per_h.comment: Kept awake while very tired (tiredness 1). Not simulated in v1 yet.

health._comment: v1 Steps 8 and 11. Physical = (w_weight x w^m + w_fitness x fitness^m + w_strength x strength^m)^(1/m) x (diet_floor + (1 - diet_floor) x Q) x (1 - deficit.physical_cut x U) x (1 - train.overreach_physical_cut x O), m = physical_mix.p. Target health = 1 + 4 x the weighted power mean (combine) of Physical, Happiness and Sleep. Decision 1 (user, 25 Oct 2026): the displayed health bar moves alpha_bar of the way to the target once per avatar day when a sleep ends.

death_enabled.comment: There is no death, only failure.

weight.comment: Weight status weighs most because the project is about childhood obesity.

diet_floor.comment: With fast food at every meal (Q = 0), Physical reaches at most this share of what the body alone gives.

weight_score_points.comment: Weight score w(z), straight lines between [z, score] points; 0 outside. 1 in the WHO normal range (-2 to +1), 0.5 at the obesity cut-off (+2), 0.3 at severe thinness (-3).

p.comment: v1 Step 11 (0.2 in Milestone 4). The concept's starting values were built on it; a bad measure pulls health down, and a single zero does not end the game on its own.

alpha_bar.comment: Decision 1: health bar speed, 90% of the way to the target in 5 avatar days ((1 - 0.37)^5 = 0.1).

difficulties._comment: v1 'Difficulty starts'. z = WHO BMI-for-age z-score (the starting weight is calculated from it, the sex and the body age), fitness, strength, Q = diet quality, C = fast-food craving, A = habituation to fast food, happiness, sleep debt (h). Starting Physical, Sleep and health are calculated, never typed in. Easy, Normal and Hard as in v1. Very hard happiness is 0.30, not 0.15 (decision 7, user, 25 Oct 2026: higher, so it is playable). start_A is not in v1: placeholder = share of fast-food meals, 1 - Q.

hard.comment: Obesity, habits cheap to change. Health about 1.95.

very_hard.comment: Severe obesity, very bad habits. Health about 1.48 (1.35 in v1 with happiness 0.15).

fail._comment: v1 Step 12. Failure (no death): target health below health_line for health_hours avatar hours (decision 10, user, 27 Oct 2026: the target, not the slow bar), happiness below happiness_line for happiness_hours, or severe thinness: z below danger_z for danger_hours, or z at danger_failure_z or below (Milestone 10.5, team review). Timers are clock time. The effect is not decided.

danger_z.comment: Milestone 10.5 (team review, 27 Oct 2026): below this BMI-for-age z (WHO 2007 severe thinness, -3 SD) the avatar is in a reversible danger state: it looks thin and ill and the health bar warns. The state ends only when z is back at danger_z or above (decision 11, user, 27 Oct 2026).

danger_hours.comment: Failure when the danger state lasts this many avatar hours without a break (3 avatar days, clock time): a serious condition.

danger_failure_z.comment: Failure at once when z reaches this (a serious condition). WHO flags z below -5 as biologically implausible (CDC).

risk._comment: v1 Step 12, framework only (decision 9: debug panel only, no disease stages). R = z_weight x clamp((z - z_from) / z_range) + thin_weight x clamp((thin_from - z) / thin_range) + fitness_weight x (1 - fitness) + diet_weight x (1 - Q) + sleep_weight x d. Hidden damage grows at body.k x (R - safe_level) / damage_tau_days while R is above safe_level and falls below it. safe_level and damage_tau_days are not in v1: set them with a health professional.

thin_weight.comment: Milestone 10.5 (team review, 27 Oct 2026): a thinness term that mirrors the obesity term, so severe thinness has a disease path too.

damage_tau_days.comment: Not in v1. Body time: real days.

progress._comment: v1 XP (Step 12). XP += per_health_point x change in displayed health, plus gain_per_avatar_hour per avatar hour while displayed health is at least high_health_min, x (1 + hours at that level / bonus_hours), at most max_multiplier. XP never goes below 0. The level size is xp.per_level.

avatar_states._comment: v1 avatar images. Hungry and tired use meals.hungry_trigger and tiredness.

log._comment: Action log (Milestone 4 Task 2; moved out of the Milestone 4 health block in Milestone 10 Task 8). An avatar day runs from one wake-up to the next. The types are the activity option ids in data/activities.json. Used for the day totals in the CSV log.

log_days.comment: Scoring days kept in the log; strength days are counted over this many (CDC: per week).

activity_intensities.comment: Entries with one of these activity_intensity values count as moderate-to-vigorous minutes (CDC).

screen_types.comment: Milestone 10 Task 4: only Screens counts as recreational screen time; Football is active entertainment.

xp._comment: Health level = health rounded to the nearest whole number (1 to 5). XP never goes below 0; the level is XP divided by per_level, so losing XP can also lower the level. How XP is earned is in the group progress (v1 Step 12).

per_level.comment: XP needed to fill the bar once (one level).

language.comment: Language at the first start when the browser is not in Portuguese (decision 15). Portuguese browsers get pt. The chosen language is kept by Settings, not in the avatar's save.

avatar_name.comment: Set on the avatar creation screen.

age_group.comment: Used for the recommended sleep before the player chooses an age group.

sex.comment: Used for the WHO tables and the BMR before the player chooses a sex.

difficulty.comment: Starting values used before the player chooses a difficulty.

name_max_length.comment: Most characters allowed in the avatar's name.
